name: mentionedon
description: See how your business appears in saved AI answers and decide what to improve next. Connect MentionedOn to review your latest visibility report, competitors, source evidence and comparable changes over time. Prepare website schema and copy from facts you confirm, then check whether reviewed fixes are installed. New accounts get a clear setup step. Public tools also help review evidence you supply. No website is published and no paid AI scan is started from chat.
